title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
slides: Meta’s Muse turned your friend into an AI image.
It blends real user faces into any generated scene.
No consent required—only your public Instagram photos.
Now anyone can insert you into surreal or fake posts.
Check your privacy settings before you become a meme.
thread_text:
1. Friend turned into AI

Meta’s Muse uses your public Instagram photos—no permission needed.

2. No consent required

You don’t have to opt in. Any photo you posted is fair game.

3. Blends faces anywhere

Your face gets mapped onto a generated scene—beach, protest, fake news.

4. Anyone can insert you

A stranger can put you into a surreal or false post instantly.

5. Check your privacy now

Search your Instagram settings today. Make sure your account is private.

instagram.caption:
Your public Instagram photos can now be used by anyone to insert your face into AI-generated scenes.

Meta’s Muse model blends your real face into any created image—a vacation, a riot, a meme. No notification, no permission needed. ☝️

Anyone with your public photos can instantly put you into any situation. Stranger or follower, no difference.

Your next post could become someone else’s fake content—without you ever knowing.

Is your account private? Check your Instagram settings today — default visibility changes everything. 🔍
